name: Plan Mode
description: 让 AI 在执行任何改动前先输出计划并经用户确认；执行过程中逐步更新计划完成状态，显示在对话底部计划面板。包含两个工具：codingto_plan_present（输出计划+确认）、codingto_plan_update（更新步骤完成态）。
tool_description: Present an execution plan and wait for user confirmation before any mutating action; track step completion in the bottom plan panel via codingto_plan_present / codingto_plan_update.

parameters.name: steps
parameters.description: 有序步骤列表，每项含 index 与 text
